entry.title: No agenda, no rush, no leaving San Francisco: Benchmark’s partners on investing in a frenzied market
entry.summary: Benchmark may have grown its funds and swapped out some partners, but onstage the five who are left sounded like friends who just happen to be running one of the Valley’s most storied firms

entry.title: Khosla Ventures doubles down on Even Healthcare to challenge India’s hospital economics
entry.summary: Even Healthcare reaches a $300 million valuation in a Khosla Ventures-led round as it plans to expand its hospital network in India.

entry.title: Laplace Intelligence red-teams robots and self-driving cars before they hit the real world
entry.summary: University of Michigan spinout Laplace Intelligence uses AI agents and interactive simulation to stress-test robots and self-driving vehicles before deployment. The profitable startup is competing in Startup Battlefield at TechCrunch Disrupt, October 13-15 in San Francisco.

entry.title: Musk pledges to give ‘every kid in America’ one of his SpaceX shares
entry.summary: Musk's post came just a few hours after Anthropic promised to put 5% of its shares into a new "public benefit fund," which it intends to use to make "large donations to traditional nonprofits or direct distributions to specific populations" after its upcoming IPO.

entry.title: Apple updates guidelines to ban nudify apps masquerading as regular apps to pass review
entry.summary: The company updated its guidelines with strong language around AI and user-generated content, and how app developers should include enough preventative measures to moderate objectionable or offensive content.

entry.title: Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs
entry.summary: Nvidia is leaning hard into the trend of enterprise companies wanting to run their own open models in their own data centers and also trying to make on-device, private AI agents a thing.

entry.title: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
entry.summary: Fed up with ads, tracking, and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.

entry.title: Amazon to fund 12 small nuclear reactors at former Indiana coal plant
entry.summary: Amazon and X-energy have inked another deal to deploy nuclear power to the grid. This one will generate nearly 1 gigawatt of electricity.

entry.title: Rivian’s CEO says autonomy will enable ‘dramatically different’ vehicle designs
entry.summary: Founder and CEO RJ Scaringe said he thinks autonomy will allow his company to build radically different kinds of vehicles than the outdoorsy SUVs and trucks it currently makes.

entry.title: AI assistant startup Town nabs unicorn valuation 4 months after launch
entry.summary: AI assistant startup Town nabbed a unicorn valuation on Monday, announcing a $108 million Series B round co-led by Forerunner Ventures and Menlo Ventures.

entry.title: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation to scale open-weight AI chips
entry.summary: After drawing acquisition interest earlier this year, the Nvidia challenger raised $1.5 billion to remain independent.

entry.title: Replika’s founder built the AI assistant she pitched at Disrupt 12 years ago
entry.summary: Eugenia Kuyda's newest startup Wabi is positioned to take advantage of an idea she had more than a decade ago. Wabi offers a personal AI assistant with a twist, free and downloadable to anyone today.

entry.title: Tolan snags $30M for its AI companion that helps users navigate life
entry.summary: AI companion app Tolan has raised another $30 million after attracting more than 250,000 active users.

entry.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
entry.summary: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.

entry.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
entry.summary: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.

entry.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
entry.summary: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents that employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.

entry.title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
entry.summary: The idea of embedded evaluators — in which supposedly "neutral" third-party observers are placed inside AI organizations — has been popularized over the last several months, as AI labs grapple with a rash of safety incidents that have spurred concerns over the potential harms of their technology.

entry.title: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45B compute deal
entry.summary: If the deal goes through, it would be the latest in a long string of giant compute deals Anthropic has struck over the past year.

entry.title: Mamdani says feds have abdicated on AI, urges New Yorkers to push back
entry.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Monday night that New Yorkers must resist the narrative that an AI takeover is inevitable and demand regulations that protect the public and put power back in their hands.

entry.title: Walmart’s Flipkart is quietly building a food delivery challenger in India
entry.summary: Flipkart has expanded access to its food-delivery service to thousands of employees ahead of its public launch.
